content: Note that when the keyword-specific expectation $e^{(t)}$ in Equation DISPLAY_FORM7 is high, the selected microposts will be the ones that contain keywords indicating the irrelevance of the microposts to an event category. Such keywords are also useful for model training as they help improve the model's ability to identify irrelevant microposts.
